items.title: Floci 2.3.0
items.summary: Cognito passkeys and TOTP MFA, EC2 instances that join EKS clusters as nodes, ElastiCache serverless caches, more CloudFormation resources, and a dashboard with light and dark themes.

items.title: floci-az 0.15.0
items.summary: Adds the Azure Policy control plane, blob index tags, Cosmos DB stored procedures and triggers, Event Grid dead-lettering and an App Service managed identity endpoint.

items.title: floci-gcp 0.11.0
items.summary: Adds the Locations API with opt-in strict location checks, Cloud Run service IAM enforcement, and opt-in per-project API enablement in Service Usage.

items.title: floci-oci 0.5.0
items.summary: Each tenancy gets its own Object Storage namespace and home region, regional resources are isolated by region, and kubectl authenticates to OKE with oci ce generate-token.

items.title: Floci now has an agent skill, shipped with floci-cli
items.summary: It teaches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kiro and other coding agents to run the emulators with floci-cli and point your cloud tools at them. Install it with: npx skills add floci-io/floci-cli

items.title: Floci 2.2.0
items.summary: Scheduler gains retry backoff and dead-letter queue handling, and API Gateway and AppSync VTL rendering is now sandboxed with execution limits.
